summary: FDM-printable six-piece Mini-ITX enclosure, 152 x 260 x 252 mm, for ASUS ROG STRIX Z390-I GAMING, Thermalright AXP120-X67, inverted Colorful GeForce RTX 3060 NB DUO 12G V3 L-V, a 200 mm riser, front-panel-integrated far-end GPU cradle, and a rear-inserted standard SFX PSU.

required_interfaces.description: Retain ASUS ROG STRIX Z390-I GAMING 170 x 170 mm on the three user-retained approximately 6.35 mm integral printed support points, with the lower-front point deleted, while preserving rear I/O and backside M.2 clearance.

With the service side removed, permit side insertion, seating at the support plane, rearward engagement of the standard I/O aperture, access to all three retained screw axes and removal without trapping the motherboard.
Fit the Thermalright AXP120-X67 envelope and preserve side-panel intake clearance.

Fit the inverted Colorful GeForce RTX 3060 NB DUO 12G V3 L-V using the user-measured 241 x 132.5 x 41 mm card body, an 8.8 mm rearward PCIe bracket-ear extension for a 249.8 mm total CAD envelope, a 106 mm rear dual-slot opening centered at X=-43 mm and the raised lower PCIe retention bracket. Preserve an approximately 8.5 mm outboard screw land. The front-panel-integrated far-end cradle must provide at least 1 mm clearance per side and remain free of interference with both front 80 mm fan frames. The prior CAD 8-pin location proxy is not authoritative and must not be used for collision acceptance; the user confirms the actual connector does not interfere with the current cradle and owns the cable solution.

Provide two front-panel 80 mm fan positions on the motherboard side and one forward base 120 mm fan position, retaining the 71.5 mm and 105 mm standard screw squares. Each airflow field uses an integral grille of rounded stadium slots, a continuous outer rim and approximately 3 mm or wider printable ribs.
Permit rear straight-line insertion of a 125 x 100 x 63.5 mm SFX PSU with assembly clearance, four 4.2 mm mounting holes at 113 x 51.5 mm spacing and unobstructed driver channels.

Use eight 10 x 5 x 2 mm rectangular magnets in compact adhesive, screwless pockets on the front and rear end panels. Provide 10.5 x 5.5 mm planar pocket dimensions with 0.5 mm total allowance in length and width, retain an exact 2.0 mm pocket depth so bonded magnets finish flush, and keep only one compact local carrier per station with no oversized perimeter frame, laminated backing guard or hidden connection neck. Use matching steel strike features on the removable side panels. Keep the rear panel body screw-fastened and all retention features outside hardware service envelopes.

Use the user-selected power button from Tmall item 655230136762. The user has confirmed the purchased variant is the Φ8 mm mounting size. Use an 8.2 mm target printed-panel cutout as the disclosed FDM clearance default, while retaining the established upper-left location centered at X=+50 mm and Z=227 mm in the enclosure frame (+X is left when viewed from the exterior front). Verify the received threaded body and printed-hole calibration before the production print. The current CAD deliverable intentionally excludes the purchased switch body, button cap, actuator and internal cable path.

external_references.description: User-selected Tmall front-panel power button item 655230136762; the user has confirmed the selected product is the Φ8 mm mounting variant.

assembly_story.installation: Remove the service side panel; insert the Mini-ITX motherboard from the side while forward of the rear panel, bring it onto the three retained approximately 6.35 mm integral printed support points, slide the rear I/O into the aperture and install three M3 screws directly into the printed self-forming holes. Then install the PCIe riser and inverted dual-slot GPU. Fit the removable front panel so its integral U-shaped cradle slides along the GPU length and supports the far end through the intended soft pad. Install the two front 80 mm fans and forward base 120 mm fan through their standard mounting holes behind the integral rounded-slot grilles. Push the SFX PSU straight in from the rear and complete the six-panel enclosure assembly.
assembly_story.maintenance: Remove the front panel along the GPU longitudinal axis so the integral cradle slides free with the panel; no separate GPU-support part is handled. Remove the appropriate magnetic side panel for routine access. The motherboard screws are intended for normal service rather than high-cycle repeated disassembly; avoid over-tightening. Remove the screw-fastened rear panel only when rear service access is required.
user_access: SFX AC inlet and rear mounting screws
removable side and front service panels

documents.description: Complete printable Mini-ITX enclosure assembly with three retained integral motherboard support points, SFX rear insertion, inverted dual-slot GPU support integrated into the removable front panel, two front 80 mm and one base 120 mm rounded-slot fan grilles, a power-button mounting aperture and six enclosure panels
